behavior: When someone enters the center of 44 CISTERN, it starts swimming toward them.
One round after beginning its approach, it urinates in anticipation and fills the air with an ammonia stink.
On the following round, it loses patience and begins swimming on the surface.
When noisy wall-breaking vibrations reach it, it arrives in 5+1d4 minutes and waits on the cistern bottom near the mouth of the underwater tunnel.
It rests in 8 PIT 2-in-6 of the time.
capabilities: Climbs the slick walls at 46 DAYLIGHT as fast as a human can.
hidden: The author recommends attacking it in 8 PIT when it is resting there, using fire and sharp things while it struggles to climb out.
The White Temple regards it as their godling.

reactions.response: The Lamb starts swimming toward that person.
reactions.stimulus: A person enters the central 50-foot-by-50-foot area of 44 CISTERN.

reactions.response: It urinates in anticipation, filling the air with the stink of ammonia.
reactions.stimulus: One round passes after the Lamb starts approaching.

reactions.response: It loses patience and swims on the surface.
reactions.stimulus: Another round passes after the ammonia warning.

reactions.response: It arrives in 5+1d4 minutes, then waits on the bottom near the underwater tunnel mouth.
reactions.stimulus: The wall at 44A is broken down noisily.
The party fishes for it with the hook hand and acceptable bait for the first time.

fields.role: The creature that hunts entrants in the cistern and can be fought, lured, ensnared, or killed.
fields.title: The Lamb

hidden: The Temple's expected response to the Lamb's body entering its drinking fountain is swift and forceful.

reactions.response: A swift and forceful response can be expected.
reactions.stimulus: The Lamb is dragged up by the noria and viscerally ejected into the White Temple's drinking fountain.

relationships.relationship: The White Temple regards the Lamb as its godling.

fields.role: The organization above the cistern that receives water from the noria and may retaliate if its godling is expelled into its drinking fountain.

contents: Sixteen huge water-stained pillars, each about 5 feet in diameter.
A 60-foot-tall noria of stout lumber near the south wall, extending into the ceiling and constantly spilling water.

discoverable.condition: Enter the central 50-foot-by-50-foot part of the room.
discoverable.information: A glow of sunlight is visible from the north.

discoverable.condition: Gain line of sight to 46 DAYLIGHT.
discoverable.information: A thick pillar of dusty light fills 46 DAYLIGHT.

discoverable.condition: Closely observe the noria and where it enters the ceiling.
discoverable.information: The noria carries water up to the White Temple and dumps it into a trough; there is no human-sized space to escape through the mechanism.

fields.first_impression: Ten-foot-deep water fills a vast chamber crowded by sixteen huge, water-stained pillars. A towering wooden waterwheel near the south wall splashes and creaks loudly.
hazards: Deep water slows swimmers who carry items.
The Lamb can pursue swimmers at 10 feet per round.
The moving noria can crush the Lamb against the slotted ceiling if it is ensnared.
hidden: As soon as someone enters the central 50-foot-by-50-foot area, the Lamb begins swimming toward them.
resources: A table can serve as a makeshift boat.
Planks or similar objects can serve as paddles.
The noria can be used as an environmental weapon against the Lamb.
Harpoons, hooked nets, ropes, and burning oil are suggested tools for fighting the Lamb here.
fields.title: 44 CISTERN
triggers: Entering the central 50-foot-by-50-foot area starts the Lamb's approach sequence.

contents: Sixteen barrels containing water, stamped with the insignia of the White Temple.
A rowboat containing 2 flasks of oil.
Stairs ascending to a locked steel door.
fields.first_impression: Sixteen water barrels stamped with the White Temple insignia stand here beside a rowboat. Stairs ascend to a locked steel door.
hidden: The locked steel door leads to the White Temple's kitchen cellar.
No one answers a knock at the locked steel door.
resources: The rowboat can be rowed by 1 person at 20 feet per round.
The rowboat contains 2 flasks of oil.
fields.title: 45 BARRELS

contents: Barely submerged rubble made from broken stairs.
Stone stairs 20 feet above the rubble.
fields.first_impression: Barely submerged rubble from broken stairs provides room for one person to stand beneath stone stairs suspended 20 feet overhead.
hazards: The surrounding walls are slick and require two Movement checks to climb, one for each 10 feet.
hidden: The elevated stairs rise 60 feet to a wooden trapdoor; the printed destination is internally inconsistent.
fields.title: 46 DAYLIGHT

uncertainties.description: The route text uses '46A TRUMPET (not on map)' and '46B FREEDOM', while the keyed headings are '46A STATUE' and '46B TOWER'; the trumpet and the route to freedom are both described under 46B TOWER.

contents: Stairs going up 40 feet to 46B FREEDOM.
fields.first_impression: A circular room 30 feet in diameter contains a statue of Vandoh and two locked steel doors.
resources: The statue can be toppled to block the trapdoor.
fields.title: 46A STATUE

uncertainties.description: The route text uses '46A TRUMPET (not on map)' and '46B FREEDOM', while the keyed headings are '46A STATUE' and '46B TOWER'; the trumpet and the route to freedom are both described under 46B TOWER.

contents: A 40-foot drop to the ground and freedom.
fields.first_impression: The top of one of the White Temple's towers holds a trumpet. The ground—and freedom—is 40 feet below.
resources: The trumpet can be taken from the tower top.
fields.title: 46B TOWER

uncertainties.description: The route text uses '46A TRUMPET (not on map)' and '46B FREEDOM', while the keyed headings are '46A STATUE' and '46B TOWER'; the trumpet and the route to freedom are both described under 46B TOWER.

steps: Topple the statue of Vandoh so it blocks the trapdoor.
fields.title: Block the 46A Trapdoor with Vandoh's Statue
fields.trigger: The party wants to prevent the trapdoor at 46A from opening.

steps: Allow the Lamb to be dragged along with the waterwheel.
The waterwheel crushes the Lamb against the slotted ceiling.
If the Lamb is ejected into the White Temple's drinking fountain, expect a swift and forceful response from the Temple.
fields.title: Crush the Lamb with the Noria
fields.trigger: The party manages to ensnare the Lamb in the noria.

steps: Accept the hook hand and bait as a valid fishing setup.
Let the first attempt work automatically.
fields.title: Fish for the Lamb
fields.trigger: The party tries to fish for the Lamb using the hook hand and acceptable bait.

steps: Choose either a grappling-hook attempt or a climb up the slick walls.
For a grappling hook, make an Attack roll against AC 15; success reaches the stairs.
For a climb, make two Movement checks, one for each 10 feet of the ascent.
After reaching the stairs, ascend 60 feet to the wooden trapdoor.
fields.title: Reach the Elevated Stairs at 46 DAYLIGHT
fields.trigger: A character tries to reach the stone stairs 20 feet above the rubble.

uncertainties.description: The route text uses '46A TRUMPET (not on map)' and '46B FREEDOM', while the keyed headings are '46A STATUE' and '46B TOWER'; the trumpet and the route to freedom are both described under 46B TOWER.

steps: Move the rowboat at 20 feet per round while 1 person rows it.
fields.title: Row the Boat at 45 BARRELS
fields.trigger: One person rows the rowboat found at 45 BARRELS.

steps: Use a battlemap for the cistern fight.
Track as many as 3 groups of people paddling or swimming.
Allow environmental plans using combinations of harpoons, hooked nets, ropes, burning oil, the hook hand, bait, and the noria.
Apply the separate swimming and boat-speed procedures while resolving movement.
fields.title: Run a Fight with the Lamb in the Cistern
fields.trigger: The party insists on fighting the Lamb in 44 CISTERN.

activation.condition: The party chooses to fight the Lamb in the cistern instead of attacking it while it rests in 8 PIT.

approaches: Use harpoons, hooked nets, ropes, and burning oil in combination.
Fish for the Lamb with the hook hand and acceptable bait.
Ensnare the Lamb in the noria so the waterwheel drags and crushes it.
completion: The Lamb is killed in the cistern.
outcomes: The first acceptable hook-hand fishing attempt works automatically.
An ensnared Lamb can be dragged by the noria and crushed against the slotted ceiling.
A Lamb ejected into the White Temple's drinking fountain can bring a swift, forceful response.
fields.perceived: The cistern becomes a difficult moving battle across deep water, boats, swimmers, pillars, and the operating noria.

possible_effects.condition: The party gets the Lamb ensnared in the noria.
possible_effects.description: The noria can crush and kill the ensnared Lamb against the slotted ceiling.
The White Temple may respond swiftly and forcefully if its godling is ejected into its drinking fountain.

stakes: The party must kill or survive the Lamb while movement is constrained by deep water.
Using the noria to kill the Lamb can provoke the White Temple.
fields.title: FIGHTING THE LAMB
